content: In another experiment we would like to only feed contextual word embeddings for Focus word/ ‘LAT’, paragraph/ Context as input to the question answering neural network. In this experiment we would neglect all embeddings for the question text except that of Focus word/ ‘LAT’. Our assumption and idea for considering focus word and neglecting remaining words in the question is that during training phase it would make more precise for the model to identify the focus of the question and map answers against the question’s focus. To validate our assumption, we would like to take sample question answering data and find the cosine distance between contextual embedding of Focus word and that of the actual answer and verify if the cosine distance is comparatively low in most of the cases.
